label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off. E2 is the survey team's own observation of potentially productive land left unused, an indirect-evidence target; E1 also reports prolonged non-use after armed-group presence. The evidence does not confirm EO, but cancellation criteria are not met, and the national criteria provide no technical survey, so a target proceeds to clearance.
flags: The evidence supports suspected, not confirmed, contamination; this is a recommendation for sign-off, not a final decision.
The nearest recorded accident is within 1 km, not reported inside ECV-0051; it is not being treated as an in-area accident record.
The zone flag and survey priority are planning information, not evidence.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1, E2.

E1.quote: A man who hunts and fishes said people stopped using the land beside the stream after an armed group camped there around 2003, and nobody has used it since.
E1.note: The local land user reports armed-group presence and prolonged non-use, which suggests possible contamination but does not confirm EO; his account of local land-use history is treated as first-hand.

E2.quote: The survey team saw that a field in part of the area has been left unused for years, with collapsed fences and overgrown paths, although the land around it is farmed.
E2.note: The team's own observation of potentially productive land left unused is indirect evidence of possible contamination, not evidence of safe use or absence.
